systems.platform: plateforme numérique de gestion du Registre
systems.owner: Minister in charge of local affairs (keeps the register, through a management unit in the ministry); Centre national de l'informatique for technical and operational tasks
systems.tiers: Draws on the civil status registers of the communes; local collectivities are among the bodies entitled to access its data (Article 17); civil status officers must update it within seven days (Article 16)

note: A decree of 15 May 2020: it requires civil status officers to update a national register and entitles local collectivities to access it, but a law places nothing and it states no office connected or working online.
